Rich already supports orange text. Any of these works in a style, for example `console.print("Hello", style="dark_orange")`, `style="orange1"`, `style="orange3"`, or a hex value such as `style="#ff8700"`. The named colors are listed in the [colors appendix](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/appendix/colors.rst), and the style syntax is in the [style docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/style.rst).

For usage questions, please use [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions).
